title: Tensor compatibility of strict henselizations for a finite map
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a finite ring map and $A\to C$ any ring map [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field with a geometric point of $\operatorname{Spec}(B\otimes_A C)$ [def-weil-geometric-point, def-pc-fibre-product], and let $p$, $q$, $r$ and $m$ be the induced primes of $A$, $B$, $C$ and $B\otimes_A C$. Form the strict henselizations $A_p^{\mathrm{sh}}$, $B_q^{\mathrm{sh}}$, $C_r^{\mathrm{sh}}$ and $(B\otimes_A C)_m^{\mathrm{sh}}$ using the pointed etale-neighbourhood construction and the embeddings into $\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. The canonical map induced by the four structure maps is an isomorphism
$$B_q^{\mathrm{sh}}\otimes_{A_p^{\mathrm{sh}}}C_r^{\mathrm{sh}}\cong(B\otimes_AC)_m^{\mathrm{sh}}.$$
It is compatible with the maps to $\operatorname{Spec}B$, $\operatorname{Spec}C$ and $\operatorname{Spec}(B\otimes_AC)$, and with the chosen geometric point.
